build_graph_from_particles: build a GraphsTuple from particle positions, types, box dimensions, and edge threshold using make_graph_from_static_structure
apply_random_rotation_to_graph: apply a random rotation to graph edges for data augmentation using apply_random_rotation on a GraphsTuple
test_graphbasedmodel_with_parameters: test the GraphBasedModel with configurable n_recurrences and mlp_sizes on a GraphsTuple input
run_graph_construction_test: run the test_make_graph_from_static_structure test to verify graph construction from particle data
run_graph_model_parameterized_test: run the parameterized GraphModel test across no_propagation, multi_propagation, and multi_layer configurations
